scope: mechanical identification, contamination removal, grade sorting, and value comparison

workflow.title: Identify brass-bearing item
workflow.instruction: Record source such as plumbing fittings, valves, hardware, electrical parts, radiators, or mixed assemblies.

workflow.title: Verify base metal
workflow.instruction: Use exposed base metal, context, magnet response where useful, and buyer rules rather than judging only by surface color or plating.

workflow.title: Separate clean and mixed
workflow.instruction: Keep clean yellow/red brass categories and contaminated or attached brass-bearing items separated according to local buyer grades.

workflow.title: Remove easy attachments
workflow.instruction: Mechanically remove accessible steel, plastic, rubber, or other attachments only when the value increase justifies the labor.

workflow.title: Preserve plated material evidence
workflow.instruction: If an item is plated, document the plating and base metal before cleaning so Board Sense and Recovery Lab retain the source information.

workflow.title: Time-value check
workflow.instruction: Compare clean-grade value against mixed-grade value and labor minutes before processing the batch.
